name: No wildcard permissions
description: Fail Roles and ClusterRoles that use wildcard apiGroups, resources, or verbs.
long_description: ISM-1883 (partial): RBAC and service-account findings show Kubernetes privilege breadth; they do not prove authorisation workflow, human account lifecycle or external systems.
remediation: Replace wildcard permissions with explicit resources, apiGroups, and verbs.

provenance.rationale: Kubescape control C-0187 currently points to a cluster-admin enumeration rule rather than a rule dedicated to wildcard RBAC fields.
